name: Campaign email
goal: Go from a brief to an approved email in a day, without five rounds of changes.

assistant.greeting: Hi, I can help you get this email written and signed off. Ask me about subject lines, the rules or your brand.

answers.reply: Keep subject lines under 50 characters so they don't get cut off on a phone. The draft gives you three to choose from.
Under the Spam Act, every marketing email must say who it's from and have an unsubscribe link that works. The draft always includes both.
If the email has an offer, it needs the end date and a link to the full terms. The check flags any offer without them.
Use a main image at least 1200 pixels wide, and only images we have the rights to. Add a short description for people who can't see it.
Tuesday to Thursday mornings tend to get the most opens. You can pick the send date in the brief.

assistant.fallback: In the real app I'd answer that from your brand guidelines. For now, try asking about subject lines, unsubscribe links, offers or images.

steps.label: Brief
steps.goal: Tell us who it's for and what you want them to do, so the first draft is close.

fields.label: Who's it for?
options: Customers who haven't bought in 6 months

fields.label: Main message
fields.hint: What they need to know, in a few sentences

sample.Who's it for?: Customers who haven't bought in 6 months
sample.Main message: Get your air conditioner serviced before the summer rush. Book before 31 December and save 20% on a standard service. Same-week appointments in most areas.

steps.label: Brand assets
steps.goal: Add your logo, images and offer terms. Each one is checked against the brand as you add it.

checklist.name: Logo
checklist.check: PNG or SVG with a clear background, at least 400 pixels wide
checklist.sample: The logo is a small JPEG with a white box around it

checklist.name: Main image
checklist.check: At least 1200 pixels wide, and one we have the rights to use
checklist.sample: The image is 640 pixels wide and will look blurry on most screens

checklist.name: Brand guidelines
checklist.check: The current version, with colours, fonts and tone of voice
checklist.sample: The guidelines are from 2023 and show the old colours

checklist.name: Offer terms
checklist.check: Gives the end date, who's eligible and any exclusions
checklist.sample: The terms don't say when the 20% offer ends

steps.label: Draft email
steps.goal: Here's the email in our brand and tone, with subject lines to choose from and the rules already checked.

steps.label: Sign-off
steps.goal: The marketing manager sees the finished email and the checks, and approves it to send.

config.confirmText: The email won't go out until it's approved again. Say what needs to change so the next draft gets it right.
